title: Relative monoidal right adjoints preserve inert edges
statement:
Use the nonsymmetric monoidal infinity categories, inert arrows and strong and lax monoidal functors of [def-coef-monoidal-infinity-category], and coherent relative adjunctions of [lem-coef-cocartesian-relative-right-adjoint]. Let $E^\otimes\to S$ and $D^\otimes\to S$, $S=N(\Delta^{\mathrm{op}})$, be monoidal infinity categories, in containing universes, and let $L:E^\otimes\to D^\otimes$ be a strong monoidal functor over $S$. Suppose its underlying functor $L_1:E\to D$ admits a right adjoint $R_1$. There is a right adjoint $R:D^\otimes\to E^\otimes$ relative to $S$, whose restriction over $[r]$ agrees under the Segal equivalences with $(R_1)^r$, including $r=0$. Its unit, counit and triangle homotopies lie over the identity of $S$. The functor $R$ preserves inert edges, hence is lax monoidal. The comparison for an operation with input tuple $(d_i)$ is the mate under the fibre adjunction of the tensor of counits
$$L_1\left(\bigotimes_i R_1d_i\right)\simeq\bigotimes_i L_1R_1d_i\longrightarrow\bigotimes_i d_i.$$
For zero inputs this uses the strong monoidal unit equivalence and the unique empty product of counits. These comparisons include all substitution and unit coherences.

source.place: Higher Algebra Corollary 7.3.2.7 and proof, printed pp.1292-1293, specialized to nonsymmetric monoidal infinity categories; the same product-of-fibre-adjoints argument over N(Delta^op). Relative unit and counit convention is Proposition 7.3.2.6. Online source read; archive WANTED. No Stacks tag.
